Initial release — free automatic subtitle generation for videos via cloud processing.

- Upload videos up to 500MB (MP4, MOV, AVI, WebM) and auto-generate subtitles in multiple languages.
- Simple workflow: upload, specify desired subtitle languages, and download a 1080p MP4 with captions.
- No local software required; all processing handled on secure cloud GPUs.
- 100 free credits with quick setup; authentication via one-click anonymous token.
- Supports preview, timeline editing, export control, and checking credit balance directly in chat.
